verdict.rationale: Dagster has no native natural-language interface. It does document an official Dagster+ MCP server that lets users access information and take actions in their deployment from an AI session, so an external AI client can provide natural-language operation. It also maintains a dagster-expert skill that gives coding agents context for building projects. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface, MCP support beyond Dagster+ (OSS coverage unevidenced), documentation of which actions can be performed via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
